metadata.description: Magpie — a plain-markdown memory for everything your AI agent reads and watches.

plugins.name: magpie
plugins.description: Capture videos, articles, sites, and competitors into a durable markdown library through the lens that matches why you're consuming it: learn, research, steal, rival, or content. Includes the caption-first capture engine, living rival dossiers that diff over time, and doctor/forget/digest maintenance verbs.
